product.title: The League in a Box
product.summary: Design the rules of a league, then meet the league you designed.
product.whatStudentsDo: Students set nine governance levers — a spending cap, revenue sharing, a tax on high spenders, contract limits, draft order, rookie pay, expansion pace, player movement and enforcement — then ratify them. The engine profiles the league they built, names its character, and shows a matrix of who wins and who loses under those rules.
product.technology: single-file HTML build plus a React/Vite rewrite published from docs/

studentDataProfile.notes: State kept in browser localStorage only; no server call observed.

governance.maturityBasis: Complete and reachable in two implementations, with a committed build output. No student-run evidence exists.
